description: project_members.removeProjectMember (DELETE /v1/projects/{idOrName}/members/{uid}): the live API returns 404 `not_found` both for a non-member uid ("Team Membership not found.") and for a deleted project ("Project not found.") — probed 2026-08-13 — but the spec declares no 404. The provider's idempotent delete catches the typed NotFound; add the response so it exists in the union.
